## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing page hero, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience.

**Claims (checked against the policy):**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Loose leaf tea | Product fact, fine as written |
| Packed by hand in Bristol / Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol | On the policy list (Operations) |
| Certified organic by the Soil Association | On the policy list (certificate renewed 2026, so not past review) |
| Free UK delivery on orders over £25 | On the policy list (shipping policy) |

No stats, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials, urgency or green claims appear.

**Regulated claims:** Nothing on health, environment beyond the certified organic claim, children or discounts. The price threshold matches the shipping policy.

**House style:** No banned words and no AI tells. The tone is plain and warm. One small edit: "packed by hand in Bristol" appears twice in a row. I'd cut the first sentence, which gives:

> Every tin of our loose leaf tea is packed by hand in Bristol, and it's certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

This is optional and doesn't block publication. If you use the tightened version, it needs a fresh check and approval for that exact text.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own page, not an ad, partnership, affiliate link or AI-labelled content, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing changed in the draft. The only suggestion is the optional tightening above.

**Needs a decision:** Which version to use, the original or the tightened one.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Nothing goes live until Sam gives an explicit yes to the exact final text. I haven't recorded any approval.
